claims.title: Arbitrary fixed-dimension Full/Mid mixtures preserve the rectangular operational potential
claims.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
claims.statement: For each fixed positive common first dimension a, every actual complex degeneration between finite shared-first-leg sums of Full(a,b) and Mid(a,b), with arbitrary positive widths, multiplicities and independent invertible first-leg identifications, preserves every AVZ26 operational potential for positive theta of sum one. The partial-sum score has a finite nonnegative expansion in two oriented symmetric-power flattening rank families.
dependencies: DO01 Definition 2.1 and Theorem 3.1 over C
Local graded propagation and finite discrete curvature identities
claims.limitations: Fixed full shared first dimension at both endpoints; smaller first subspaces and shared-output blocks are outside the theorem. Not a universal tensor character or exponent lower bound. Same-session mathematical audit is not independent review. No tensor construction or exponent improvement.

claims.title: Two dimensions bound heterogeneous Full/Mid target scores from identical source blocks
claims.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
claims.statement: For all positive common first dimensions a, widths B and source counts c, the two long-leg dimension inequalities alone imply every positive-theta rectangular operational score inequality from c identical Full(a,B) blocks to arbitrary shared Full(a,b_i) and Mid(a,d_j) targets. The identical-Mid-source version follows by transposition.
dependencies: AVZ26 positive-width concavity, endpoint upper bound, and exact affine tails
Local supporting-slope dual with nonnegative endpoint intercept
claims.limitations: Only identical source blocks and full shared first dimension; does not construct a degeneration. The dimension statement is scalar and does not use the complex determinant theorem. No independent review, formalization or exponent improvement.
